name: scout-workspace
description: Scout: a browser companion that hands website agent resources to your agent and suggests links.

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:mac
scripts.test:node: npm run test:node --workspaces && vitest run --root scripts --exclude '**/*.mac.test.*'
scripts.test:mac: npm run test:mac --workspaces && vitest run --root scripts .mac.test. && npm run test:swift
scripts.test:agent-contract: vitest run --root packages/scout-core src/agents src/capabilities src/integrations && vitest run --root packages/scout-mcp && vitest run --root scripts agent-check
scripts.test:swift: cd native/Scout && swift build && swift test
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
